Raised in a Care Home.name: Raised in a Care Home
Raised in a Care Home.description:
🏡 You grew up in a children's home with a dozen other kids and staff who changed over the years.

🍳 You cooked for a crowd and looked after the little ones.
💪 You learned to stand on your own early.

📈 Grants: Cooperativeness +1, Childcare +5, Cooking +5
Raised in a Care Home.traitNarrativeEffects: Grew up in a children's care home; why is the player's to define, else left unstated for the player to raise. Left at eighteen like most residents; managing alone since. In play: the home is a real place to visit; the narrator may create original characters for its director, a favorite caregiver and a few children who look up to the character and follow their progress on the news. Gaps: renting or signing hospital forms needs a family guarantor they lack; no one sends money; holidays are quiet when classmates go home. Pressure and opportunity: some pity them, some expect trouble, and recruiters who target the lonely, villains included, look for this history. Classmates, a mentor or a team can become chosen family if the character lets them. Treat it with dignity, never as tragedy for its own sake. Childhood: shared rooms, chore charts, cooking for many, helping younger kids with homework and bad nights, caregivers who came and went, a few adults who kept in touch.
